description: Shared object definitions for the judgment namespace.

judgment.description: A single judgment about a linguistic item.

item.description: Reference to the item being judged. Use recordRef for the communication/annotation record, objectId for a specific object within it, localId for same-record references.

fillingRef.description: Reference to the pub.layers.resource#filling that generated the item being judged.

scalarValue.description: Numeric response value (ordinal-scale rating, magnitude estimate, or rank position).

textSpan.description: Selected text span for span-labeling tasks.

confidence.description: Annotator's stated confidence in this judgment, scaled 0-1000.

behavioralData.description: Behavioral signals: mouse movements, keystroke patterns, eye tracking data, scroll events, etc.

regionResponses.description: Per-region reading-time or response measurements for this judgment, one per region of the presented stimulus (self-paced reading, eye-tracking region analysis).

features.description: Open-ended features carrying judgment detail not covered by the typed fields.

experimentDesign.description: Experiment design parameters for item distribution, ordering, and timing.

listConstraints.description: Constraints on item list construction (Latin square balancing, no-adjacent-same-condition, etc.).

distributionStrategyUri.description: AT-URI of the distribution strategy definition node. Community-expandable.

distributionStrategy.description: How items are distributed to annotators.

itemOrderUri.description: AT-URI of the item order definition node. Community-expandable.

itemOrder.description: How items are ordered within a list.

timingMs.description: Target timing per item in milliseconds.

features.description: Open-ended features carrying experiment-design detail not covered by the typed fields.

listConstraint.description: A constraint on item list construction for an experiment.

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the constraint kind definition node. Community-expandable.

targetProperty.description: The item property this constraint operates on (e.g., 'condition', 'templateRef').

parameters.description: Constraint parameters (e.g., minimum distance, number of lists).

presentationSpec.description: How stimuli are displayed to participants.

methodUri.description: AT-URI of the presentation method definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

chunkingUnitUri.description: AT-URI of the chunking unit definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

chunkingUnit.description: How text is segmented for incremental presentation (fallback when chunkingUnitUri unavailable).

cumulative.description: Whether previous chunks remain visible during incremental presentation.

refreshRateMilliHz.description: Display refresh rate in millihertz (e.g., 60000 for 60 Hz).

pixelsPerDegree.description: Pixels subtending one degree of visual angle at the stated viewing distance.

sessionRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.session whose clock and setup this presentation was delivered under.

participantRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.acquisition.participant records presented under this specification.

mediaRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.media.media records delivered as stimuli under this specification.

features.description: Open-ended features carrying presentation detail not covered by the typed fields.

regionResponse.description: A per-region reading-time or response measurement within a judgment, addressing one region of the presented stimulus (e.g., in self-paced reading or eye-tracking region analysis).

region.description: Reference to the region being measured. Use recordRef for the stimulus record, objectId for a specific region object within it, localId for same-record references.

regionIndex.description: Zero-indexed position of this region within the stimulus presentation order.

regionRoleUri.description: AT-URI of the region role definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

regionRole.description: Analysis role of this region (fallback when regionRoleUri unavailable).

readingTimeMs.description: Total reading time on this region in milliseconds.

firstFixationMs.description: First-fixation duration on this region in milliseconds.

gazeDurationMs.description: Gaze (first-pass) duration on this region in milliseconds.

goPastMs.description: Go-past (regression-path) duration on this region in milliseconds.

totalTimeMs.description: Total dwell time across all fixations on this region in milliseconds.

regressionsOut.description: Count of regressions launched out of this region.

regressionsIn.description: Count of regressions landing in this region.

fixationCount.description: Number of fixations on this region.

responseTimeMs.description: Response time in milliseconds for a per-region response task (e.g., maze, grammaticality-at-region).

scalarValue.description: Numeric per-region response value (e.g., rating at this region).

features.description: Open key-value map for per-region measures not covered by the named fields.

recordingMethod.description: A data capture instrument used in an experiment.

methodUri.description: AT-URI of the recording method definition node. Resolves into the shared modality node set in layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub (the same nodes backing media signalInfo.modalityUri and catalog contentSummary.modalityUri). Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

sessionRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.session whose clock this recording was captured on.

participantRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.acquisition.participant records this recording captured.

mediaRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.media.media records produced by this recording instrument.

features.description: Open-ended features carrying recording-method detail not covered by the typed fields.
